objective: Parse and verify every available WoW API for each supported product, then generate Basic, Modern, and Advanced real-world automation-oriented examples.

source_roles.Baneto Source Code: example complexity/style inspiration ONLY; never API authority

hard_rules: An API may be used in an example only if verified for the target product/build.
Baneto source must never establish API availability.
Unknown or unverified APIs must not be silently substituted or included.
Global Functions documentation does not imply availability in every expansion.
Examples may combine multiple verified WoW APIs.
Examples should be standalone functions where practical.
Examples target practical addon/bot automation use.
next_tasks: Import Ketho branch data for Retail, Classic, Classic Era, and Classic Anniversary.
Implement generated-example dependency extraction and validation before example generation.
